## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and the design boundary affected by this change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when UI, Sidecar, MCP, or lifecycle behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when behavior or contracts changed
- [ ] No generated runtime files, project databases, logs, or secrets are included

## Security and compatibility

Describe changes to approvals, hooks, networking, persistence, migrations, or platform support. Write
`None` when the change does not affect these boundaries.
